title: Assert a 404 JSON error contract
summary: Missing resources return a stable JSON error shape.
description: Call GET /items/999 on the same Express app and assert status 404 plus { error, id }. Compare how Supertest, Playwright request, and pytest + httpx check an HTTP error contract.
architecture: Same HTTP integration shape as GET success, but the contract is the error: 404 and { error: "not_found", id: "999" }. Clients must not treat a missing item as an empty 200. The app is the only source of that JSON; tests do not stub the handler.

variants.label: Playwright
variants.notes: Uses Playwright's APIRequest context only — no browser is launched.

variants.label: pytest + httpx
variants.notes: Spawns samples/js-api/scripts/serve-ephemeral.mjs so httpx talks to the same Express app.
